text:
Marta Reyes: Quick design idea: use a watermark-driven reconciliation plus a small delta-ledger for corrective events. Goal is remove the ingest-time ownership race and keep consumers reading a single reconciled stream.
Jon Park: High level: how is delta-ledger different from an append-only ledger with corrections?
Marta Reyes: Delta-ledger keeps compact base events (the canonical charge) and tiny correction records that reference base_event_id + watermark when they become stable. Reconciler applies deltas at watermark boundaries to produce effective charge records per billing window.
Hannah Li: How do we decide watermark boundaries? Fixed window or adaptive?
Marta Reyes: Start with fixed windows (1h billing windows for reconciliation) with a configurable lateness allowance (e.g., 15m). We can iteratively move to adaptive windows if tail latency requires.
Jon Park: Consumers will want low-latency reads for near-realtime dashboards. Does this force them to wait for the watermark?
Marta Reyes: No. We expose two read paths: 1) ingest-stream: raw events + deltas (best-effort, eventual) and 2) reconciled-stream: canonical per-window outputs (SLA-backed). Dashboards can poll the ingest-stream for provisional numbers and switch to reconciled-stream for final billing figures.
Hannah Li: Auditability is critical. We need to be able to explain every billed token back to producer traces.
Marta Reyes: Reconciler emits a proof-bundle per window: {proof_id, window_start, window_end, reconciled_event_ids, ledger_refs}. The proof-bundle contains signed pointers to delta-ledger records (not full payloads) so auditors can fetch the referenced ledger slices if needed.
Jon Park: Can you paste a minimal delta-ledger record schema?
Marta Reyes: Sure:

```json
{
  "delta_id": "sha256(...)",
  "base_event_id": "e_98765",
  "tenant_id": "t_55",
  "watermark": "2026-03-18T16:00:00Z",
  "delta_tokens": -12,
  "reason": "credit_returned",
  "producer_trace": "trace:abc123",
  "refs": ["seq_12345"]
}
```

Hannah Li: That looks compact. How do we handle dedupe and idempotency across retries from upstream?
Marta Reyes: Each base_event carries a producer_id+nonce and dedupe is performed at ingest. Deltas reference base_event_id so the reconciler can apply at-most-once semantics using the delta_id. We also keep a small TTL-index for recent dedupe state.
Jon Park: Migration plan? We have a lot of consumers wired to current handshake outputs.
Marta Reyes: Phased approach: 1) dual-write: ingesters write both existing handshake path and delta-ledger + raw stream, 2) run reconciler in shadow/compare mode and produce proof-bundles to a compare topic, 3) onboard one consumer (billing) to reconciled-stream, validate parity and SLA, 4) incrementally flip consumers and deprecate handshake. Each phase has automated parity checks and an allowlist for early adopters.
Hannah Li: Operational concerns: reconcilers could fall behind with big backfills.
Marta Reyes: We'll add backpressure controls: reconcilers get a backfill-queue with priority tiers and we snapshot reconciler state periodically. For emergencies we have a forced re-run endpoint to replay specific windows.
ops-bot: action_item: add reconciliation-lag alert (SLO: <5 min for normal windows, <1h for heavy backfill).
Jon Park: Cost tradeoffs? Extra storage for deltas and snapshots and more CPU for reconcile passes.
Marta Reyes: Expected delta storage is small (corrections are rare relative to base events). Snapshots reduce repeated compute. We gain simpler ingesters and far fewer cross-service handshakes which lowers operational costs.
Hannah Li: One more: multi-tenant isolation for Dedicated/private installs?
Marta Reyes: Delta-ledger is partitioned by tenant and can be sharded per-customer. For private deployments we provide a self-contained reconciler binary and optional encrypted ledger export.
reconciler-bot: shadow-run metrics: parity_diff=0.003 (0.3%), top-3 diff causes: 1) clock skew, 2) duplicate producer nonces, 3) enrichment ordering.
Marta Reyes: Good. Action items: - draft RFC with design + schema + migration checklist, - instrument dedupe telemetry, - implement proof-bundle fetcher for audits, - add reconciler health dashboard.
Hannah Li: +1 from product (will add acceptance criteria).
Jon Park: +1 from infra (will scope snapshots and sharding options).
Marta Reyes: I'll open the RFC this afternoon and tag folks. Thanks! :rocket:
